INSERT INTO account_research_pipeline_runs (
            organization_id,
            account_id,
            researched_account_id,
            trigger,
            status,
            current_stage,
            started_at,
            finished_at
         )
         VALUES (
            $1,
            $2,
            $3,
            'MANUAL_START',
            'SUCCEEDED',
            NULL,
            now() - interval '10 minutes',
            now() - interval '5 minutes'
         )
